title: Soaring Aerotech Identity
content: Soaring Aerotech Pvt. Ltd. is Central India's complete drone company. It is Indore's first DGCA-approved Remote Pilot Training Organization (RPTO) with Authorization Number: 40/2023. Under the legacy of the Prestige Group, it is incubated at AIC-Prestige Inspire Foundation (supported by NITI Aayog, Government of India).

title: Facility and Infrastructure
content: We operate a 50,000 sq ft state-of-the-art facility in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, dedicated to UAV manufacturing, research & development (R&D), and has a dedicated drone flying field.

title: Leadership and Directors
content: The company is led by our directors: Mr. Himanshu Jain and Dr. Manojkumar Deshpande, along with key team members including Lalit Nagapurkar (R&D Manager), Aditya Agrawal (Accountable Manager), Vaibhav Sawarkar (Business Development), Abhishek Chourasiya (R&D Engineer), and Ashish Bamnawat (Training Coordinator).
